mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in monthly CPI inflation above 0.5 percentage points signals an impending monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth and monthly housing starts signals a weakening demand cycle, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings face headwinds from reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from their prior values.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (below 4.0%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production indicates robust supply chain activity and manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 200-day moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as retailers face lower sales and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 700,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 3.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle amid high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high labor market slack (PAYEMS growth below 0.5% monthly), a further slowdown in employment growth signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as corporate hiring and investment decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 0.5% monthly.
